description: Structured JSON contract for Claude's generated migration assessment. Every roadmap phase and risk entry must cite source_ids from the retrieved knowledge base documents used to ground it.

complexity_rationale.description: 1-2 sentence explanation of the score, referencing scenario specifics

items.source_ids: array of knowledge base doc ids that informed this phase
array of knowledge base doc ids that informed this risk

cost_band.basis: string explaining what drove the range

sources_used.description: Deduplicated list of all knowledge base doc ids referenced anywhere in the output — used to render the sources panel in the UI

generation_rules: Every roadmap phase and risk entry MUST include at least one source_id from the retrieved documents provided in context.
Do not invent a source_id that was not part of the retrieved set.
If no retrieved document supports a claim, omit the claim rather than generating it ungrounded.
Respond with valid JSON only — no markdown fences, no preamble.
